integrity: All six finite maxima are recomputed by a standalone exhaustive verifier. Error balls are generated by two independent implementations, explicit attaining codes are checked, and maximum-clique upper bounds use only a proved greedy-coloring bound and exhaustive branching.
scientific_limitations: The exact statement is restricted to the binary exact \((3,1)\)-burst channel and \(3\le n\le8\). No claim is made for longer blocklengths, variable-length bursts, or nonbinary alphabets; literature comparison cannot exclude unindexed or unpublished finite computations.
title: Exact binary \((3,1)\)-burst code sizes through length \(8\)
